accepted.evidence: The primary grammar explicitly derives causative piy-ay- make drink from piy- drink with -ay (< *-av), and identifies piy-āvd- as its perfect stem and piyayipey as its infinitive. Link all three ordinary forms of this derived causative to the existing same-source base piy (f_hqru4n3h67n7w); its accepted compiled ancestry is pibati8209. This records a source-defined synchronic derivation, not direct inheritance of the entire causative from Sanskrit.
